item.title: Code Optimization Demo & Reading Time
item.author: me@example.org (Your Name)
item.description:
Code Optimization Demo & Reading Time

This page demonstrates code blocks (syntax highlighting + language label + copy button) and reading time / word count on a longer body. It also shows the common “before vs. after” optimization pattern.

Scenario: summing optimization

A plain Python implementation is intuitive, but readability and edge-case handling can be improved.

Before (naive loop):

def sum_before(n):
    total = 0
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        total += i
    return total

After (Gauss formula, O(1), with input guard):

item.title: HugMedia Theme Development
item.author: me@example.org (Your Name)
item.description:
HugMedia Theme Development

This is a project page example, used to test a top-level section (besides posts) and to demonstrate SEO-related front matter (description / keywords).

Project goals

Build a simple, maintainable, out-of-the-box Hugo theme:

  • Switch among five social-platform styles (xhs / zhihu / wechat / medium / quora)
  • Multilingual (zh-hans primary / en secondary)
  • Built-in site search, dark mode, responsive layout

Tech choices

  1. Template dispatch: define + template
  2. Build: Hugo css.Build + js.Build
  3. Math: KaTeX; diagrams: Mermaid

Record of Yueyang Tower (excerpt, from Guwen Guanzhi)

An excerpt from Fan Zhongyan’s “Record of Yueyang Tower”, used to demonstrate headings, paragraphs, blockquotes, lists, tables, flowcharts, and images.

Part 1 · Narration

In the fourth year of Qingli, Teng Zijing was banished as governor of Baling Commandery. The following year, governance was smooth and the people harmonious; all neglected affairs were revived. He therefore rebuilt the Yueyang Tower, enlarged its original scale, and had the prose and verse of the Tang sages and his contemporaries inscribed upon it. He charged me to compose a record for it.

item.title: Triple Integral: Volume of a Sphere in Spherical Coordinates
item.author: me@example.org (Your Name)
item.description:
Triple Integral: Volume of a Sphere in Spherical Coordinates

This page demonstrates how math formulas (KaTeX: inline and display) appear in example content.

Setup and change of variables

Let the sphere be $B = { (x,y,z) : x^2 + y^2 + z^2 \le R^2 }$. Use spherical coordinates:

$$ x = \rho\sin\varphi\cos\theta,\quad y = \rho\sin\varphi\sin\theta,\quad z = \rho\cos\varphi $$

with $\rho \in [0, R]$, $\varphi \in [0, \pi]$, $\theta \in [0, 2\pi]$. The Jacobian is $\rho^2\sin\varphi$.
